title: Qwen D1-v2: correct inspect target, invalid packet shape
summary: Qwen selected the requested primitive and correct visual target twice, but omitted a required null field. The validator dispatched no action.

title: Qwen D1-v3: valid first action, then provider ingress rejection
summary: Turn 1 executed correctly. Bedrock rejected the two-image turn-2 history before Qwen returned an output, so this is instrument technical missingness rather than model behavior.

title: Qwen D1-v4: bounded history completes the 12-turn C_native path
summary: The controller evicted superseded viewport pixels without adding a semantic summary. Bedrock accepted every request and Qwen completed all 12 required transitions on first proposals.

title: Qwen D2-v2 episode 011: state changed before reference evidence was acquired
summary: The single-call action component correctly recognized that the third card was the reference, but clicked CHANGE STATE before inspecting it. The third card then became V5. Qwen inspected that post-change card, stored V5 as the reference code, and terminally selected V5 instead of R2.

title: Qwen D3 episode 006: correct memory followed by an unsupported post-shuffle target claim
summary: The first policy requested evidence and Qwen read and retained code R2. After the fixture shuffled the cards, the final low-information overview withheld every code. The policy still remembered R2 but, without requesting new evidence, incorrectly claimed it was the third card. The grounder followed that exact policy, clicked the third card, and selected V5.

title: RecGaze transfer episode 003: second inspect exceeded the frozen image-count envelope
summary: S2 executed two inspect actions on the real RecGaze training UI. The next C_pixel policy request required the current overview plus both retained sharp crops, exceeding the frozen two-image limit even though raw image bytes stayed below their ceiling. The guard correctly prevented the request, leaving the paid block incomplete at 3 of 72 episodes. This is an instrument failure, not evidence that the model or S2 failed the browsing task.
